description: Tasks excluded from leaderboard scoring, with reasons. Raw run JSONL still contains them; aggregation must filter by this file.

uncovered.reason: Mutation calibration: suite still passes with the target function replaced by unimplemented!(), so these tasks cannot distinguish a correct solution from a stub. Root cause: their tests require docker-compose services (glue/hms/datafusion catalogs) that the paper's `make unit-test` never starts.

leak_stripped_not_excluded.reason: These two tasks embedded the reference Rust body in their dependency block; the harness strips the exact AST node from the prompt at load time, so they remain scoreable. Disclosed for transparency.
